delivered.ended_team_treatment: TeamView derives `teamEnded` from the served payload: the head's DERIVED `phase === "ended"` AND/OR a carried `endedAt` (resolved by `endedInstantOf` from the head, falling back to the workspace listing row with the same team id — the listing is where the route serves the stamp today). When ended: (a) a dedicated ended statement replaces the raw phase chip — a chip reading `ended` plus the RELATIVE age (`data-mpd-team-ended` carries the same age for machine readers); (b) the running/ready tally row, the progress bar and the `Progress N%` counter are NOT drawn; the final `completed/total complete` figure still is; (c) each member card drops its `current` work line, its status dot loses the live status (title `ended`, neutral tone) and its fraction reads `x/y complete` as a FINAL tally. Nothing is deleted from the payload and `data-member` stays on every card.
delivered.relative_age: `relativeAgeOf` is a LOCAL helper in this package (the planes are DUPLICATED code; no cross-package import), with L4's exact thresholds: `<1s`, `Ns`, `Nm`, `Nh`, `Nd`, and `?` for an absent/unparseable instant (epoch 0 included, matching `subagentRowAge`). Exposed additively as `relativeAge` on the returned module, the same way `formatElapsed` already is, so the vocabulary is provable directly.
delivered.reconciled_fact_honoured: The WEB plane has NO subagent-row surface, so there is nothing to burn there (no row filter was invented). What the web renders is team MEMBER cards; the treatment lands on exactly that surface, and the ended marking is a RENDERING decision over the served record, not a filter/delete.

The session-scoped head served by `/plugins/mpd-team/state` carries `phase` (the store's DERIVED terminal phase) but NOT `endedAt`; the ending INSTANT rides the `workspaceTeams.records[]` listing in the same payload. `endedInstantOf` therefore reads the head first and the listing row (same team id) second — verified against the route BOTH ways: `buildTeamState` serves the head without the stamp, `buildWorkspaceTeams` spreads it on the listing. If neither carrier has a readable instant, the panel prints `ended ?` rather than inventing an age (the same `?` the TUI helper answers for unusable instants). Enriching the HEAD with `endedAt` is a route change in `packages/mpd-team-core-plugin/src/team-web.ts`, OUTSIDE this lane's write scope, and was reported to the captain.
The pre-existing header stamp `approved <ISO>` is unchanged: it is a record stamp, not an age, and clause A5's no-ISO rule is about the TUI's subagent rows. Only the ended age is relative.
